unavailable_fields.pcie_bytes: Capability probe left this unknown; hardware byte counters require a successful collector-specific probe and topology or logical payload (497759232 bytes per rank per step) does not measure traffic. device_telemetry provides device-wide NVML PCIe rates with native ~20 ms sampling windows and unavailable exact boundaries, not per-collective bytes.
unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: Unknown for the same hardware-counter probe reason; additionally the observed NCCL channels use SHM/direct/direct between ranks with peer_access.0.1=0 and peer_access.1.0=0, so no NVLink carriage is evidenced to measure.
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: Unknown; hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe. Only device-wide NVML gpu/memory utilization readings exist, and device_telemetry re-samples those same device-wide readings.
unavailable_fields.nccl_wait_vs_wire_split: Not directly measurable: NCCL kernel durations include waiting (rank 1 sum 244.90 ms vs rank 0 58.96 ms on identical matched collectives), and nsys timelines do not separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer. collective_calibration is a synthetic reference experiment for comparison, not a split measurement or lower bound.
unavailable_fields.cross_rank_arrival_skew: The observed clock policy forbids subtracting timestamps from different rank clocks; execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions only, so absolute inter-rank kernel arrival offsets remain unknown.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion: execution_timeline associates CPU submissions with CUDA launches within reported clock alignment bounds, but GPU-side input readiness and downstream consumer completion may remain unknown; no collector here observes them directly.
unavailable_fields.clean_host_dispatch_cost: python_runtime was not selected: the trace shows no host-dispatch-bound evidence (3999/3999 kernels associated, zero unmatched communication kernels), and its warmed cProfile run perturbs execution with inclusive/self times that are not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations; this dimension is left unknown rather than measured with a distorting tool.

plan.rationale: The torch collector already ran with complete coverage: 13 cross-rank matched f32 SUM RING_LL allreduces (12 buckets of 7087872 elements plus one of 39385344), payload observed for 13/13 collectives, every bucket identity attributed via observed gradient-storage membership plus matched parameter inventory, and zero unmatched communication kernels. The open questions for step_ms and diagnostic.max_rank_nccl_kernel_sum_ms are: (1) rank asymmetry - rank 1 communication_kernel_sum_ms 244.90 vs rank 0 58.96 on the same matched collectives (per-bucket ~13.9-16.7 ms vs ~3.2 ms, first bucket 54.7 ms on rank 1; only the final 39385344-element collective is symmetric at ~19.4 ms), which indicates peer-arrival waiting inside NCCL kernels rather than wire time; and (2) exposure - communication_without_compute_ms 55.16 (rank 0) / 235.50 (rank 1) vs compute_overlap_ms 3.81 / 9.40, so communication is mostly exposed, and the submit-side cause (bucket readiness vs CPU/synchronization timing) is unknown. collective_calibration runs a separate synthetic full-world SUM allreduce at the actually observed sizes/dtypes with correctness checks, giving reference context to interpret the in-training kernel inflation; it is a reference experiment, not a performance lower bound or critical-path estimate. device_telemetry samples device-wide NVML PCIe tx/rx, utilization and memory with native windows to corroborate wire activity on the observed SHM/direct/direct host path (no P2P), never per-collective bytes. execution_timeline records a separate plain Torch trace with CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization, per-device intervals, clock alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions, and passive gradient post-accumulate callbacks to attribute bucket readiness and skew; it replaces no communication hook and determines no subsequent search actions. nsys is available and selected narrowly to corroborate overlap/exposure structure and submit attribution via native correlation; it is explicitly not used to separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer or to prove bucket identity (already observed). Excluded: torch (already ran, complete); python_runtime (no host-dispatch-bound evidence, perturbs execution, times are not clean scores); candidate_diagnostics (no candidates exist at the collection stage; avoids indiscriminate requests).
